title: feat(header): context-aware Help & Documentation menu + app-scoped docs index
body:
## Why

The top-right **?** in the console header was a bare external link to `docs.objectstack.ai` — it duplicated the left sidebar's in-product `/docs` entry and ignored the ADR-0046 in-product docs hub entirely. This makes it earn its place by being **context-aware**.

## What

**Help menu (`AppHeader`)** — the "?" is now a dropdown:
- **This app's docs** — shown *only* when the current app's package owns docs (matched by `_packageId`). A single-doc app deep-links straight to the viewer; a multi-doc app lands on the new app-scoped index.
- **All documentation** → the in-product `/docs` portal.
- **Online documentation** → `docs.objectstack.ai` (new tab).

Docs are lazily fetched once on first menu open (names/labels only — no `content`), so the menu adds zero cost until used; a failed fetch soft-degrades to the static entries.

**App-scoped docs index** — new route `/apps/:packageId/docs` (`AppDocsIndex`), the package-scoped sibling of `/docs`, listing just that app's docs. This is what "This app's docs" targets when an app ships more than one doc.

**i18n** — `help.appDocs` / `help.allDocs` / `help.onlineDocs` added to `en` + `zh`; other locales fall back to `en`.

## Verification (live: showcase backend + console)

- Help menu opens in the Setup app with all three items and zh labels (本应用文档 / 全部文档 / 在线文档).
- "This app's docs" deep-links to `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/docs/setup_overview` (single-doc app) and renders.
- `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/docs` (`AppDocsIndex`) renders the Setup overview card.
- "This app's docs" is correctly **hidden** in the Account app (package owns no docs — verified against `/meta/doc`).
- `tsc --noEmit` on `@object-ui/console` is clean.

Pairs with framework#1845, which seeded the first-party Setup/Studio docs this surfaces.
